This contrasts with FanDuel, which mandates login-gated CSV imports, introducing a procedural barrier. The slate discovery protocol filters upcoming NFL contests based on game type and start time, yielding a draftGroupId that uniquely identifies the player pool. The system assumes that anonymous requests with proper TLS impersonation bypass Akamai protections, and that no documented rate limits exist, allowing flexible polling cadences. Player data is deduplicated by playerId, ensuring consistent representation in downstream models. The risk of ToS violation is minimal for read-only salary pulls, as enforcement targets republished lobby data or automated entries rather than passive reads. This creates a dual-layered operational model where GSI validates data integrity while GSE manages state transitions and caching policies.
